attacks.claim: Links open in a new tab (target=_blank) with no visible or screen-reader hint, and the '…' is appended as bare text after the truncated body.
attacks.evidence: {t.value}

attacks.claim: Truncation counts characters only, and the body uses white-space: pre-line. A short description with many newlines can still render tall, so the collapse may not fully fix the borrow button being pushed down the page.
attacks.evidence: Descriptions over 280 characters now render collapsed (no line-count limit)

attacks.claim: Neighbor-authored links display the raw text but can be lookalike or punycode domains. The mitigation is only rel noopener/nofollow and the http(s)-only filter, which is acceptable for this scope.
